map.由实际利率与通胀求名义利率: Finding the nominal interest rate from the real rate and inflation
map.输入实际利率 r 与通胀率 π，求名义利率。: Enter the real interest rate r and the inflation rate π to get the nominal interest rate.
map.📖 查看「由实际利率与通胀求名义利率 使用指南」: 📖 Read the "Finding the Nominal Rate from the Real Rate and Inflation Usage Guide"
map.📚 深度解析：由实际利率与通胀求名义利率: 📚 Deep Dive: Finding the Nominal Rate from the Real Rate and Inflation
map.名义利率：录入实际利率与预期通胀，算名义利率。: Nominal rate: enter the real rate and expected inflation to get the nominal rate.
map.实际利率：由名义利率减通胀得实际利率（近似）。: Real rate: subtract inflation from the nominal rate to get the real rate (approximately).
map.教学演示：演示通胀预期上升推高名义利率。: Teaching demo: show that rising inflation expectations push the nominal rate up.
map.示例：实际利率 2%、通胀 3%，名义利率≈5%。: Example: a real rate of 2% and inflation of 3% give a nominal rate of about 5%.
map.近似式 i≈r+π；精确为 (1+i)=(1+r)(1+π)，低通胀下差异小。结: The approximate form is i ≈ r + π; the exact one is (1+i) = (1+r)(1+π), and the difference is small at low inflation. Results are for economics teaching and quick estimation only; they are not investment advice or a policy basis, and for forecasts and empirical estimates defer to official statistics and textbooks.
map.费雪用预期通胀；事后可用实际通胀反推已实现实际利率。结果仅作经济学教学与快速测算: Fisher uses expected inflation; after the fact you can back out the realized real rate from actual inflation. Results are for economics teaching and quick estimation only; they are not investment advice or a policy basis, and for forecasts and empirical estimates defer to official statistics and textbooks.
map.名义利率低于通胀即实际为负，鼓励借入、抑制储蓄。结果仅作经济学教学与快速测算参考: When the nominal rate is below inflation the real rate is negative, which encourages borrowing and discourages saving. Results are for economics teaching and quick estimation only; they are not investment advice or a policy basis, and for forecasts and empirical estimates defer to official statistics and textbooks.
